en: Heyyyy! Show yourseeeelf!

Where you hiding!?
Come, talk to Gontaaaa!

Gonta?
Are you looking for Kokichi?
No, not Kokichi...
Gonta see tiny bug!

No mistake this time! It definitely fly by
Gonta's eyes!

Heeeey bug! Come out agaaaain!
Gonta just wanna taaaaalk!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tiny bugs again...
Gonta's been talking about them for a while.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure he's interested, as the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>But...the memory of the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltMIND> is still raw...

Heyyyyy! Come out, come out wherever
you arrrre!

Where you hiding bug!?
Come talk to Gontaaaaa!

We haven't come across Kokichi at all.
I wonder where he could have gone...

If he's not in the courtyard...
is he inside somewhere?

You're...probably right. But apparently
Kokichi is quite good at hide-and-seek.

If he's serious about hiding from us, finding
him may prove to be quite troublesome.
Troublesome?
Why do you look so surprised?
Ah, no, it's nothing.

Please tell me! You don't need to hesitate.
After all, we're friends.
Well...

I just thought...perhaps a *robot*
could find a human...

Shuichi...you're not even trying to hide
your robophobia anymore.
<CLT=cltMIND>What? Really?
Anyway, Shuichi...

That black object over there looks suspicious,
doesn't it? The one with the red border.

Shuichi... That black object in the grass
over there looks suspicious, don't you think?
You know, that object with the red border.

A-A flying building?
What kind of technology is this?

We knew this place had advanced technology,
but who could have imagined this!?

<CLT=cltMIND>She's staring at Tenko's lab...
I should leave her alone.

What is it, Shuichi?
Don't stare at me so much...
Or I'll become even more beautiful...
Ah...I see.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is she embarrassed?
About something she said herself?
...Did it look like I was blushing?
What?

Before...no one could tell that I 
was blushing, right?
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, that's right, I remember!

It's becoming more and more beautiful...
Just like me.
Ah...really...?
Oh, you just made Himiko angry!

Someone like you wouldn't know this,
but this is Himiko when she's mad!
No...I was just blushing.
What!? From your own compliment!?

Yeah, you looked a little
embarrassed just now...
Hm, okay! Then I'll keep at it!
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko...is really trying to change.

I have been reborn! I won't say that 
feelings are a pain anymore!

Y-Yeah...
If I'm tired, I just gotta make a tired face...

<CLT=cltMIND>I know how she feels, but that might
be taking it a bit far.

It sure is quieter now that no one's yappin'
"Atua this, Atua that" anymore!

I knew that fuckin' midget was running
a goddamn cult!
I mean, if there really was a god...

He'd obviously make me, the gorgeous girl
genius, his chosen one!
Hah-hahaha! That kooky fuckin' bitch!

Hah-hahahahaha! That's why that kooky
fuckin' bitch died!

Ahhhhhhhh! If you put it in that deep, it's
gonna drive me crazy!

<CLT=cltMIND>After the third class trial, we've lost seven
friends. Only nine of us are left.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we've all taken Himiko and Tenko's wish
to heart. We're trying to live on.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki also decided to join us,
help us to survive.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps it's only a little bit,
but we're closer to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...
Tenko...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's not embarrassing to express your
feelings, it's only human...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko has changed,
just like you wanted.

<CLT=cltMIND>She's not so lazy anymore...
She's working hard, trying to live well.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...you exchanged your life
for that. It's not fair...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's still under construction.
<CLT=cltMIND>What are they building?

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm positive this strange building
is an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate lab<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>From the machines and the sci-fi feel,
I'd deduce this is Keebo's lab.
I'll check inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item on the stone statue,
a building rose up...
<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?
Th-The buildings just combined!

Ahhhhh! What did you do to my lab!?
It's goin' in super deep!

<CLT=cltMIND>When I placed the stone on the pedestal,
a building flew over here...

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?
Perhaps I shouldn't even think about it.
<CLT=cltMIND>Cyber Area Door Key
